projects.title: AutoVision AI
projects.label: COMPUTER VISION
projects.description: Vehicle detection and tracking in uploaded traffic videos using pretrained YOLOv8, with annotated video and CSV exports.
projects.details: Uses OpenCV frame processing and ByteTrack tracking to count unique vehicles. FastAPI connects the detection pipeline to a React dashboard. Modernizes Ahmet Özlü’s MIT-licensed vehicle_counting_tensorflow project.

projects.title: Voice Emotion Recognition
projects.label: MACHINE LEARNING
projects.description: Speech emotion classification across eight emotion classes using MFCC features and a Random Forest classifier.
projects.details: Uses the RAVDESS dataset and Librosa to extract MFCC means and standard deviations. The README reports 72% accuracy; evaluation has not been independently reproduced.

projects.title: InsightFlow
projects.label: FULL-STACK ANALYTICS
projects.description: Full-stack analytics application with separate client, server and shared npm workspaces.
projects.details: Uses Recharts, Axios, Zustand, TanStack Query and Zod for visualization, API access and state management, as described in the resume.

projects.title: NetPredict AI
projects.label: CYBERSECURITY / AI CONCEPT
projects.description: Security operations dashboard demonstrating network traffic analytics, threat forecasting and explainable AI workflows.
projects.details: Interactive scenarios, threat inspection and reporting demonstrate a proposed forecasting system. The documented benchmarks are simulated; a real Python ML backend is an integration goal.

projects.title: PRASHAM
projects.label: ENTERPRISE AI CONCEPT
projects.description: Material-code harmonization interface demonstrating duplicate detection, semantic matching and human review workflows.
projects.details: Demonstrates a proposed common material identity across public-sector enterprise catalogs. Uses illustrative records; semantic embeddings and entity resolution are proposed integrations, not validated production capabilities.
